title: Paul's Visions and His Thorn in the Flesh

questions.question: Paul says there is nothing to be gained by boasting, but he will go on to visions and ____ of the Lord.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 12:1 (ESV): "I must go on boasting. Though there is nothing to be gained by it, I will go on to visions and revelations of the Lord."

questions.question: He knows a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the ____ heaven.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 12:2 (ESV): "I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven—whether in the body or out of the body I do not know, God knows."

questions.question: This man was caught up into ____ and heard things that cannot be told, which man may not utter.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 12:4 (ESV): "and he was caught up into paradise—whether in the body or out of the body I do not know, God knows—and he heard things that cannot be told, which man may not utter."

questions.question: To keep him from becoming conceited because of the surpassing greatness of the revelations, what was given to him?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 12:7 (ESV): "So to keep me from becoming conceited because of the surpassing greatness of the revelations, a thorn was given me in the flesh,"

questions.question: What does Paul call the thorn in his flesh?
options: A messenger of Satan to harass me
questions.correctAnswer: A messenger of Satan to harass me
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 12:7 (ESV): "...a thorn was given me in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to harass me, to keep me from becoming conceited."

questions.question: How many times did Paul plead with the Lord about this, that it should leave him?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 12:8 (ESV): "Three times I pleaded with the Lord about this, that it should leave me."

questions.question: What was the Lord's response to Paul's pleading?
options: "My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness."
"Endure this for my name's sake, and you will be rewarded."
"Your faith has made you well; go in peace."
"I will remove it when the time is right."
questions.correctAnswer: "My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness."
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 12:9 (ESV): "But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.'"

questions.question: Therefore Paul will boast all the more gladly of his weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may ____ upon him.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 12:9 (ESV): "Therefore I will boast all the more gladly of my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest upon me."

questions.question: For the sake of Christ, then, he is content with weaknesses, insults, hardships, persecutions, and calamities. For when I am ____, then I am strong.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 12:10 (ESV): "For the sake of Christ, then, I am content with weaknesses, insults, hardships, persecutions, and calamities. For when I am weak, then I am strong."

questions.question: Paul says he has been a fool, but they forced him to it. He ought to have been commended by them, because he was not at all inferior to these ____-apostles, even though he is nothing.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 12:11 (ESV): "I have been a fool! You forced me to it, for I ought to have been commended by you. For I was not at all inferior to these super-apostles, even though I am nothing."

questions.question: The signs of a true apostle were performed among you with utmost patience, with ____.
options: signs and wonders and mighty works
questions.correctAnswer: signs and wonders and mighty works
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 12:12 (ESV): "The signs of a true apostle were performed among you with utmost patience, with signs and wonders and mighty works."

questions.question: In what way were they less favored than the rest of the churches, for which Paul sarcastically asks them to forgive him his wrong?
options: That Paul himself did not burden them
That they received fewer letters from him
That their spiritual gifts were lesser
That they were not visited by Peter
questions.correctAnswer: That Paul himself did not burden them
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 12:13 (ESV): "For in what were you less favored than the rest of the churches, except that I myself did not burden you? Forgive me this wrong!"

questions.question: Here for the third time I am ready to come to you. And I will not be a burden, for I seek not what is yours but ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 12:14 (ESV): "Here for the third time I am ready to come to you. And I will not be a burden, for I seek not what is yours but you..."

questions.question: Paul writes, "I will most gladly spend and be ____ for your souls."
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 12:15 (ESV): "I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more, am I to be loved less?"

questions.question: Paul fears that when he comes again his God may humble him before them, and he may have to ____ over many who sinned earlier and have not repented of their impurity, sexual immorality, and sensuality.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 12:21 (ESV): "I fear that when I come again my God may humble me before you, and I may have to mourn over many of those who sinned earlier and have not repented of the impurity, sexual immorality, and sensuality that they have practiced."

key_verse_text: But he said to me, "My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness." Therefore I will boast all the more gladly of my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
